scope: Independent source, specification, migration, evidence, acceptance and handoff review of Part 4 only. The reviewer did not implement product code or mutate canonical workflow state. Manual review probes and the review JSON were written only in the chat workspace.

verificationObserved.notes: These are observations from the current registered receipts/logs, not new test receipts created by the reviewer. Typecheck, lint and complete production build also exited zero. The six actual method browser flows and actual 50-candidate/1,225-comparison HTTP ballot are present in the current election log. Representative method and reputation screenshots were inspected alongside responsive overflow and accessibility assertions.

R20.conclusion: Strict ranked ballot validation, optional preference exhaustion, active-majority IRV transfers, published elimination/final tie rules and deterministic replay are implemented for equal and paid power. All six IRV allocation cells execute full funded settlement.

R21.conclusion: STV is the named exact inclusive Gregory variant, with integer Droop quota, fixed published seats/effective candidate limit, rational surplus factors, retained/live/exhausted conservation and replayed tie decisions. Elected IDs remain separate from the declared financial ranking; all six STV cells pass.

R22.conclusion: Batch Elo has fresh 1500 ratings, K32, simultaneous pre-period expected scores, draws and separately named paid-frequency semantics. Complete pair assignment, validation, replay and all six funded Elo cells are exercised.

R23.conclusion: The engine implements actual Glicko-2 rating, deviation, volatility, inactivity and bounded Illinois convergence. Official worked-example calculations and weighted repeated-game equivalence are tested. The unrounded rating1464.0506705393013 is consistent with the paper's1464.06 after its intermediate rounding, rather than an engine substitution. All six Glicko-2 cells pass.

R24.conclusion: Forced comparisons use exact signed +power/-power, no draws, complete canonical pair coverage, one immutable ballot and unique-voter participation. Duplicate, incomplete, foreign and ineligible ballots fail; all six funded cells pass.

R25.conclusion: All36 mandatory cells retain named versioned semantics and actual unit/funded evidence. FPTP uses vote power; advanced methods use explicit nonnegative competition-rank points with ties, never raw ratings as money ratios. Frozen rights, sealed UI/read/audit/export boundaries, canonical transcripts, SQL immutability, full veto gates, source refunds and conserved concurrent settlement remain intact. The complete pre-vote specification is now publicly linked and source-bound.

R26.conclusion: Members, schemes, legacy proposals and rounds support written1-5-star reviews. Current visible revisions determine separate target/dimension count and average. Presentation/participation and receipt-backed recipient experience are distinct; local payments do not claim project delivery or real-world performance verification.

R27.conclusion: Recorded completed shared participation is required; self, duplicate, electorate-only, cross-community/context and pending-veto-only claims are denied. Ordered edits, reports, moderation reasons and current-event appeals preserve raw history. Hidden content is excluded from public scores/history, reports remain staff-private, moderation conflicts are rejected and appealed restoration requires a different unconflicted moderator. Initial revision creation is atomic and aggregates fail closed.

manualReviewEvidence.label: Independent manual review, not an automated workflow receipt
manualReviewEvidence.results: Passed permutation replay, unique participation, complete ranking, nonnegative supports, exact allocation conservation, per-event rational STV retained+live+exhausted conservation, official Glicko calculations, weighted frequency versus repeated games equivalence and finite1e13-frequency calculations. No product writes or database changes were performed by these probes.

findings.description: DECIDED rounds initially included still-sealed veto-only participation in reputation options/eligibility, allowing pending participation to be inferred.
findings.resolution: The complete round context is unavailable until an enabled veto deadline passes, in both service reads/eligibility and SQL participant validation. Current reputation check11 proves options and eligibility remain unchanged for a pending veto-only participant.

findings.description: The full method contract existed in the repository but voters initially had no public pre-vote access to detailed elimination, surplus, rating and tie parameters.
findings.resolution: Every V4 round and creation/ballot UI links the anonymous published specification. The public text exactly matches the canonical frozen document, is included in source fingerprints, and equality/stale-evidence plus anonymous pre-vote browser checks pass.

findings.description: The coordinator identified that an orphan review root could lack a revision and a fallback could manufacture a one-star aggregate; the independent reviewer inspected the repair.
findings.resolution: An additive deferred constraint requires revision1 before commit and the read path fails closed on missing revisions. The isolated SQL reputation check rolls back a valid scoped root without its initial revision, and final aggregates use actual immutable scores only.

findings.description: Reputation documentation originally described slash-separated operations and omitted the pending-veto exclusion.
findings.resolution: The final documentation uses the actual hyphenated router operations and explains full-context veto privacy and its eligibility boundary.

limitationsAndBoundary: All Part4 financial and recipient-experience fixtures are local simulations. This review does not claim a real chain transfer, wallet approval, deployment or NEAR finality.
The declared STV and rating-period variants are versioned Fundicate specifications, not claims to reproduce every jurisdiction or an external rating federation.
Part5 real NEAR testnet operations, integrated analytics/templates/recovery and final audit remain outside this passing Part4 review; no mandatory Part4 item was waived.
